class.name: WebList
class.keywords: html css list ol ul marker
class.brief_description: A CSS-like ordered or unordered list control.
class.description: [WebList] displays items using browser-inspired [code]<ul>[/code] and [code]<ol>[/code] behavior. It supports ordered and unordered markers, list style position, list item values, per-item tooltips, hover styling, and theme properties that map to common CSS list, typography, spacing, border, and background concepts.

method.name: add_item
method.description: Adds a list item with the given text, similar to adding an [code]<li>[/code] element.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all list items.

method.name: get_hovered_item
method.description: Returns the index of the item currently under the mouse cursor, or [code]-1[/code] if no item is hovered.

method.name: get_item_at_position
method.description: Returns the item index at the local [param position], or [code]-1[/code] if the position is outside every item.

method.name: get_item_count
method.description: Returns the number of list items.

method.name: get_item_marker_text
method.description: Returns the marker text rendered for the item at [param idx], after applying [member list_tag], [member list_style_type], [member start], [member reversed], item value, and item custom marker text.

method.name: get_item_rect
method.description: Returns the local rectangle occupied by the item at [param idx]. This is useful for bridge tests and custom input handling.

method.name: remove_item
method.description: Removes the item at [param idx].

method.name: push_mouse_motion
method.description: Feeds a local mouse motion event into the list hover path. This is useful for headless bridge tests and custom input drivers that need to verify [code]:hover[/code]-style theme changes.

method.name: set_item_auto_translate_mode
method.description: Sets how the item text participates in automatic translation.

method.name: get_item_auto_translate_mode
method.description: Returns the automatic translation mode for the item at [param idx].

method.name: set_item_count
method.description: Resizes the item list. New items are created with empty text and default item properties.

method.name: set_item_custom_marker_text
method.description: Sets custom marker text for one item. When non-empty, this overrides [member list_style_type] for that item.

method.name: get_item_custom_marker_text
method.description: Returns the custom marker text for the item at [param idx].

method.name: set_item_metadata
method.description: Stores arbitrary metadata on the item at [param idx].

method.name: get_item_metadata
method.description: Returns the metadata stored on the item at [param idx].

method.name: set_item_text
method.description: Sets the text for the item at [param idx].

method.name: get_item_text
method.description: Returns the text for the item at [param idx].

method.name: set_item_tooltip
method.description: Sets the tooltip text shown when hovering the item at [param idx].

method.name: get_item_tooltip
method.description: Returns the tooltip text for the item at [param idx].

method.name: set_item_value
method.description: Sets the explicit ordered-list value for the item at [param idx], equivalent to the HTML [code]li[value][/code] attribute. Enable it with [method set_item_value_enabled].

method.name: get_item_value
method.description: Returns the explicit ordered-list value for the item at [param idx].

method.name: set_item_value_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables the explicit ordered-list value for the item at [param idx].

method.name: is_item_value_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the item at [param idx] uses its explicit value.

members.member: Controls whether size calculations follow CSS [code]content-box[/code] or [code]border-box[/code] semantics.
Language code used for text shaping and line-breaking.
Controls marker placement, equivalent to CSS [code]list-style-position[/code].
Controls marker generation, equivalent to CSS [code]list-style-type[/code].
Opacity multiplier for text, markers, and styleboxes, equivalent to CSS [code]opacity[/code].
Sets ordered-list numbering style, matching HTML [code]ol[type][/code].
If [code]true[/code], ordered markers count downward, equivalent to HTML [code]ol[reversed][/code].
First ordered-list number, equivalent to HTML [code]ol[start][/code].
Horizontal alignment of item text, equivalent to CSS [code]text-align[/code].

theme_items.theme_item: Item text color, equivalent to CSS [code]color[/code].
Item text color while the mouse hovers an item, equivalent to a [code]:hover[/code] color rule.
Text outline color used by Godot rendering. This has no direct CSS equivalent unless used to approximate text stroke.
Marker color, equivalent to styling [code]::marker[/code] with [code]color[/code].
Marker color while the mouse hovers an item, equivalent to a [code]li:hover::marker[/code] color rule.
Text weight requested by the theme, equivalent to CSS [code]font-weight[/code]. The current renderer uses the assigned [theme_item font]; bridge tests should verify the effective face.
Extra vertical spacing between items in pixels.
Additional spacing between letters in pixels, equivalent to CSS [code]letter-spacing[/code]. The current renderer exposes the value for theme parity tests.
Item line height in pixels. If [code]0[/code], WebList uses a browser-like normal line height based on the current font size.
Block-end list margin in pixels, equivalent to CSS [code]margin-block-end[/code].
Block-start list margin in pixels, equivalent to CSS [code]margin-block-start[/code].
Marker weight requested by the theme, equivalent to CSS [code]::marker { font-weight: ... }[/code].
Distance between marker and item text, equivalent to browser marker/content separation.
Minimum marker box width in pixels.
Text outline size in pixels.
Block-end padding in pixels, equivalent to CSS [code]padding-block-end[/code].
Block-start padding in pixels, equivalent to CSS [code]padding-block-start[/code].
Inline-end padding in pixels, equivalent to CSS [code]padding-inline-end[/code].
Inline-start padding in pixels, equivalent to CSS [code]padding-inline-start[/code] for default [code]ul[/code] and [code]ol[/code] elements.
Theme-level text alignment hint, equivalent to CSS [code]text-align[/code]. The node property [member text_alignment] controls the active alignment.
Font used for item text, equivalent to CSS [code]font-family[/code].
Font used for marker text, equivalent to CSS [code]::marker { font-family: ... }[/code].
Font size used for item text, equivalent to CSS [code]font-size[/code].
Font size used for marker text, equivalent to CSS [code]::marker { font-size: ... }[/code].
Focus outline stylebox.
Container stylebox drawn while any item is hovered. Use it for CSS [code]:hover[/code] background, border, padding, and box-shadow effects.
Item row stylebox drawn for the hovered item. Use it for per-[code]li:hover[/code] background, border, padding, and box-shadow effects.
Item row stylebox drawn for every non-hovered item.
Marker box stylebox drawn for the hovered item's marker. Use it for [code]li:hover::marker[/code]-adjacent background, border, padding, and box-shadow effects.
Marker box stylebox drawn for every non-hovered marker.
Main list container stylebox. Use it for CSS [code]background[/code], [code]border[/code], [code]padding[/code], [code]box-sizing[/code]-adjacent sizing, and [code]box-shadow[/code] effects.

constants.constant: Unordered list behavior, equivalent to HTML [code]<ul>[/code].
Ordered list behavior, equivalent to HTML [code]<ol>[/code].
